where: The Old Light, floor 4 — The Backwards Inn (a mirror maze, everything reversed)
mood: The Backwards Inn — the march turned inside out: the tune walks in the tuba while the oom-pah flips to the top.
_note: Classic oldlight-f4: 120, F, registers swapped then retrograde. Opening: the tuba plays the tune alone from beat one in the low register, the high 'pah-oom' answering. | Family pass (music-cue-family): conditioned on motif-oldlight (the f1 remaster's theme), strength medium; tempo moved 120->126 because motif conditioning locks takes to the anchor's 126 grid (feel carries the same pace). | NEVER name the tune in the brief: 'Punchwheel's Patter' got every conditioned plan rejected as copyrighted_material_detected; describe it ('the tower's march tune') instead.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
every section is built on the tower's own cheeky march tune, carried from the reference
tuba plays the melody low while piccolo and glockenspiel play the oom-pah offbeats up high
phrases that descend where the theme rose, mirror-image melody
reverse-cymbal swishes and backwards-sounding swells into downbeats
comic, topsy-turvy, a funhouse mirror room
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the tuba blurts the tune straight away down low while piccolo plays a high pah-oom on the offbeats, everything upside down}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the tower's march tune carried by tuba and bassoon in the low register, with piccolo and glockenspiel doing the oom-pah on top; a reverse-cymbal swish into each phrase}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {now the right way up for a moment, muted trumpet on the tune, then it flips again mid-phrase, the melody turning into its mirror image}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the tune played as if backwards, phrases descending in D minor, plucked strings and woodblock ticking, backward swells into each bar, then a slide back home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the upside-down march returns, tuba on the tune; the last bar's reverse swell sucks straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
